messages:
Maya Chen: Ok team — finalizing the cohort handoff playbook for the welcome newsletter (launch week). Primary asks: deploy schedule, QA owners, seed list, and segmentation mapping. Quick sync? :sparkles:
Ravi Patel: I can own the seg mapping + audience sheet. I'll export trial cohorts and flag exclusions. sheet -> https://docs.google.com/sheet/xxx (view only for now)
Sam Ortiz: I'll do deliverability sanity and seedlist. Need SPF/DKIM check and last-retry logs. Can we run a small send to 2k seeds before the big push? :eyes:
Lena Kowalski: Copy + creative signoff from product comms done. Two subject lines to A/B: 1) "Welcome to Redwood — Quick start guide" 2) "Get started with fast, predictable LLM inference"
Aaron Blake: Timeline idea: 10% cohort at 10am PT on Tue -> ramp 50% Wed morning -> full send Thu 9am PT. Stagger APAC by 24h windows to avoid spikes.
Maya Chen: Love the stagger. Add a canary rollback plan: if bounce rate > 5% or hard bounces spike > 0.5% in first hour, pause and rollback to backup copy. Who monitors first hour?
Sam Ortiz: I'll monitor first hour. Set alerts on bounce/hardbounce and unique opens. ops-bot plz hook: thresholds: bounce_rate>0.05, hardbounce>0.005
ops-bot: alert rule created for thread 1801234567: bounce_rate>0.05, hardbounce>0.005, deliverability-check scheduled 20m pre-send
Ravi Patel: Seg mapping notes: cohorts -> ["trial-0-7","trial-8-30","early-adopter-invite","webinar-registrants"], suppress -> unsubscribed, recent-support-contact, gdpr-optout. Will attach CSV to sheet. Also add utm params: utm_campaign=welcome_launch_v1
Lena Kowalski: CTA variants: "Start integration" vs "See quickstart". We'll A/B on cohort 0-7. Also include webinar invite in footer for webinar happening next Wed.
Maya Chen: QA checklist (short): 1) seed inbox checks (Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo) 2) link click test + UTM append 3) images load and alt text 4) unsubscribe flows 5) transactional header present
Sam Ortiz: Running seedcheck Mon 9am PT. Can we also lock subject lines by EOD today? I want to get inbox previews queued.
Aaron Blake: I'll prepare the send config: provider tags, suppression snapshot time, and rollback json. Snippet for send schedule:
```
{
  "send_windows": ["2027-05-12T17:00:00Z","2027-05-13T16:00:00Z"],
  "stagger": "region_based",
  "rollout": [10,50,100]
}
```
Maya Chen: Perfect. Last call: owners list? Seg mapping = Ravi, Deliverability = Sam, Copy = Lena, Send config = Aaron. I'll publish playbook in Notion and ping product-marketing when live. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: +1. Also reminder — seedlist should include internal aliases + 50 external addresses for ISP sample.
Ravi Patel: CSV export will include timezone column for stagger. I'll drop final sheet link here when ready.
Maya Chen: Great — final check tomorrow 9am PT. If anything changes ping this thread. Thanks everyone! :heart:
